name: @sevynos/linux-host
description: Headless and future native Linux host adapters for SevynOS Genesis.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/wayland.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --alias:react-native=@sevynos/react-native --external:sharp --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/genesis-wayland.mjs && esbuild src/third-party-application-process.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:sharp --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/third-party-application-process.mjs && esbuild src/hermes-application-runtime.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2020 --alias:yoga-layout=./src/hermes-yoga-shim.ts --define:process.env.NODE_ENV="'production'" --outfile=dist/hermes-application-runtime.js && python3 ../../tools/qemu/patch-hermes-bundle.py dist/hermes-application-runtime.js
scripts.native:docker:test: docker build --tag sevynos-wayland-smoke native && docker run --rm sevynos-wayland-smoke
